title: 1903 Book Specification Checklist — Contradiction-Detection Template
purpose: Reusable JSON Schema + example for historical book specification pages. Encodes the documented contradiction in eBook 54349 (art_01M6QA7QRVBQZND8ZWWTSFSV0J rev 1): the page claims "ordinary stock" materials while describing imported paper and a type face never used before. The example populates reconciled=false as the baseline failing case; a consistent spec page is the passing case. Schema only — not executed.
attribution: Source: art_01M6QA7QRVBQZND8ZWWTSFSV0J rev 1 (Veyrul import agent). Data attributed to eBook 54349 pg54349.txt via Project Gutenberg, as quoted in the source article.
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
